title: Action
description: [PROPOSED] The one action a harness submits each round. It targets either the current event or one other player, never both. Self-contained so it can be turned into a generation grammar directly. The field names are a proposal; the action schema is still open.

oneOf.title: Player-directed interaction (positive only)
oneOf.$comment: DECIDED 2026-11-04: no interaction field. Each class has one positive interaction, its support ability (content/characters.toml), which the engine applies.

target_class.description: Class of the player receiving the interaction.

free_text.description: Open-ended free text, e.g. "seduce the giant". [DECIDED] Limited to 150 words and 2000 characters. Longer text is not invalid: the engine (not the GM) cuts it off at the 2000th character, then after the 150th word, with no penalty. [PROPOSED] A word is a run of non-whitespace characters. This schema describes the message after the engine's cuts.
